79119.subject: Trump Agrees To CLARITY Act Ethics Rules
79119.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Republicans](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/republicans-post-final-clarity-act-text-with-trump-backed-ethics-terms)**[ posted the final CLARITY Act text with ethics terms Trump agreed to](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/republicans-post-final-clarity-act-text-with-trump-backed-ethics-terms)

* **[Balancer](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/balancer-proposes-shutting-down-and-distributing-treasury-to-bal-holders)**[ proposed shutting down and returning its treasury to BAL holders](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/balancer-proposes-shutting-down-and-distributing-treasury-to-bal-holders)

* **[Robinhood](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/robinhood-says-shares-and-votes-are-coming-for-stock-tokens)**[ says shares and votes are coming for its stock tokens](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/robinhood-says-shares-and-votes-are-coming-for-stock-tokens)

* **[Kraken](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/kraken-launches-xstocks-vaults-that-borrow-against-tokenized-equities)**[ launched vaults that borrow against tokenized equities](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/kraken-launches-xstocks-vaults-that-borrow-against-tokenized-equities)

* **[Pump.fun](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/pump-fun-drops-cashback-for-new-launches-adds-holder-rewards)**[ dropped Cashback for new launches and added holder rewards](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/pump-fun-drops-cashback-for-new-launches-adds-holder-rewards)

Ethics for elected officials was the first thing seven Senate Democrats said was missing when they walked away from the bill in July. On Monday evening, Republicans handed it to them, only one day before the vote that decides whether the bill gets debated at all.

The Jan. 20, 2029 sunset that would have ended the ban with **Trump**'s term is gone. State attorneys general, barred from enforcement outright in July, [can sue under the final text](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/republicans-post-final-clarity-act-text-with-trump-backed-ethics-terms). Civil penalties went from 10% of the take or $500,000, whichever is less, to 20% or $500,000, whichever is greater. **Cynthia Lummis** says the language carries "substantially all" of the Tillis-Gallego proposal, and that Trump agreed to it voluntarily.

Cloture ripens at **2:15 p.m. Tuesday** and needs sixty votes, which means seven Democrats. None of the seven has said a word about the text. Traders moved without them: Polymarket's odds of enactment this year went from 18% on Friday to **31%** on Monday.

**Read more below!**
